notes: v2.9.22: makes condition-search loading single-click and nonblocking. If the condition list is not loaded, one click fetches it asynchronously and automatically resumes the requested action. Manual selected-condition preview fetches the full current result first, bulk-renders rows, then attaches realtime monitoring without blocking the UI. The seven day-trading searches pipeline their initial queries on one WebSocket, collect the complete paged union, and replace the candidate list atomically only after the union is ready. Duplicate start clicks are ignored, old threads no longer block the GUI, and name/classification work is deferred until after the list is visible.
